commit_message: feat(pdp): add supplier-verified trust badges under buy buttons
acceptance_criteria: Four badges (Not Tested on Animals, Paraben-Free, Silicone-Free, Small Batch) render under the buy buttons / More payment options link on every PDP
Silicone-Free badge is suppressed on revitalizing-serum-with-growth-factor (contains Cyclopentasiloxane + Dimethicone per Vitelle INCI, 2026-07-20)
No cruelty-free certification wording or bunny-certification iconography; animal-testing claim is finished-product scoped per Vitelle email 2026-07-20
Badges wrap cleanly at desktop, tablet, 390px, and 375px with no horizontal overflow
Evidence: brain/roman/roman-products-inci-ingredients.md and archived supplier email in brain/roman/emails/vitelle-labs/product-and-pricing/2026-07-inci-and-claims/
